claims: NASA has not yet announced the specific crew members for the Artemis III mission.
The Artemis III mission is currently scheduled for 2027.
The Artemis III mission was originally planned as the first crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17.
Artemis III will involve a four-person crew.
Artemis III's four-person crew will launch in the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis III's four-person crew will launch on an SLS rocket.
Artemis III will focus on testing rendezvous and docking capabilities between the Orion capsule and commercial spacecraft like SpaceX's Starship HLS.
The first actual landing on the moon is now planned for the Artemis IV mission in 2028.
Artemis II is scheduled for early 2026.
The Artemis II crew is composed of Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialist Christina Koch, and Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen
